content: “Sigwey, timog budag yakamiy, kuliganes agulivan, mamagina akayan wasigeis yakamiy.”
Tasiyas iliganes aga-Ibliw waseg illivan, mo ikika̱pays va̱gan kid binganegs bwein. Mo ilivan.

Ilana, “Yey gum-Yudiy yey. Inag nikopweig ven Talisus waseg, wawnuwan ven avakaein Silisiy; tage bo askul ven towen Yelusalem waseg. Tamwey towen yagan Gamaliyel ikatimlakeig, mo akakin dakaleiwags ya̱kids, akakinbunik, iseiw nuwag Yowbad nawotet, ma̱wana babaw yakamiy tut towen.
“O gamag tasiyas inoyes kadetan ked, bo amop asisinap; mwasinis akatimates. Vinay o tawaw ayousis asenas wa̱deil.

“Tanuwgwes lun sitovek avakaein, o tammwayas babaw ikakins agulivan towen mounid. Peinan bo isekeigs let silma̱nin budidayas ven Damasik waseg, anounana wa̱ked silma̱nin Damasik va̱gan bayousis gamag, bameyes Yelusalem, va̱gan kid takaleiwags mo bimop asisinap.
Kweiboug Pawl ikanavin nanon
“Ya̱nay waseg anoun kadiyakusa Damasik, mo mititeilin avakaein imekeig, ma̱wana kavikawn meinoy neim walba̱lab.
“Akalouw wapwepway aligen aygan teitan; ilana, ‘Soul, Soul, aveiyag wawun kuybilebeig yey?’
“Akatimop aygan, alana, ‘O guyaw, kavel yak?’ Ilana, ‘Yey gum-Nasalet Yeisuw, mtowen tut babaw nukuybileb.’
“Tasiyas sigwey nakan, bo ikines mititeilin, tage nag biliganes aygan towen, soug yey nakallivan.
“Wankuyeim mo alivan; alana, ‘O guyaw, aveiyag bavag?’ Guyaw towen mo idibakeig, ilana, ‘Kutamanaw kun Damasik, igaw teitan gamag mo bikatimlakeim muwotet, aveiyag bakaleiwag va̱gan bukuwtel.’
“Peinan mititeilin ikaligwen matag, ta-ma̱wan bakin. Misinaka iyousis namag itokeigs, mo kan Damasik.
“Ven towen waseg taw yagan Ananiyas; min-Yudiy tasiyas misikes ven towen ikakinsa tadidumwal, peinan tavna̱sein Moses nakaleiwag towen.
“E, mtowen imekeig itamanaw itom mo ilivan; ilana, ‘Bwadag ya̱koum Soul, towen bukukin.’ Ilivan ikous mo akinbunik, akin taw towen Ananiyas.

“Mo ilivan, ilana, ‘Tammwayas siYowbad bo ikaliwageim va̱gan kid bukukwakin nanon, o bukukin tadidumwal towen, o bukuligen aygan tonen; o amsinap towen bisekeim kadiloka bukwatipel kusekes gamag babaw wasigeis. E, tut towen aveiyag kukwayamat? Kutamanaw, kutam mtowen waseg, mo babapta̱yseim, yagan tonen waseg, bo biwid mukwalbaleb, va̱gan beikous.’
Ikayeb Soul binekes kid tobwag ven gimgilis

“Ikous, na̱yum nam Yelusalem, akulul, annitoug Yowbad wanbunatum, matag mo isisawla mav, akin Guyaw towen idibakeig; ilana, ‘Nuwanaw kun kulisow Yelusalem, peinan min-Yelusalem bipiyaves amlivan, liva̱neig yey.’

“Yey alivan; alana, ‘O Guyaw, tasiyas ikakins sinagoga babaw wasigeis bo ayablebes taliganeins liva̱neim yak; mwasinis awaweiys vatul waseg, mwasinis asenas wa̱deil. Kweiboug neiweiys takanawein aygam mtowen Sitiben, yey bo a̱tam wotet towen waseg, natamanaw akikin, bo amtakavet asikweim tawayins taw towen.’
“Guyaw towen mo idibakeig, ilana, ‘Kunoun, bakayabeim bukun kadiveiyov, silma̱nin tobwag ven gimgilis.’”
Pawl ilivans son takanaviys sitovek
Anilivan babaw iligintunis, tage iliganes livan towen “Tobwag ven gimgilis,” mo iwaks avakaein, ilansa, “Singaya takalbaleb towen; kuweiys taw towen. Na-ikadilok son mwamovan bises.”
Iwkuwaksa, ilivelovs asikweim, musamusan pwepway ilivelovs ininein wanakaew, singay ikapasal nuwes.
Takanaviy sitovek mo ilivan; ilana, “Kutokes taw towen kunawes wanuwan bunatum, kuweiys vatul waseg va̱gan bikamtel aveiyag anilivan waseg ikawkunes.”

Iyawanis won Pawl; ta-ma̱wan bigogewn naman o kaken. Takalikay teitan itamanaw wadadan. Pawl mo idibek takalikay towen; ilana, “Nag kadilok bukwatima̱veigs, guma-Lom yey. Kadiloka kuyateleigs, magat bukuba̱nes agusinap kalbaleb, mo kuweigs.”
Takalikay iligen anilivan towen, inek natovek, idibek, ilana, “Aveiyag bukuvag? Taw towen guma-Lom teitan.”
Takanaviy sitovek mo inek Pawl, ikatigan, ilana, “Adok ya̱koum guma-Lom ya̱koum, ne?” Pawl ilana, “Ma̱wan.”
Takanaviys sitovek ilana, “Money avakaein bo asek, mo amlavag guma-Lom.” Pawl ilana, “Peinan kweiboug-o tamag imlavag guma-Lom, mo inag nikopweig guma-Lom tatonen yey.”
Iliganes tasiyas, ikakiws wous peinan kakita bo beiweiys Pawl; sitovek-vak anpwa̱yat seikwan, peinan guma-Lom towen bo iyawanis naman o kaken.
Pawl mo iya̱tal

Iyam nen ga̱boug mo ilikus vatul wa̱won Pawl, o peinan takanaviys sitovek sivinan bikakin wawun min-Yudiy sikavikun waseg Pawl, mo idibakes bimeis tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱veks sisiyasa takaleiwags babaw; teitan mo itok Pawl, imey, itamanaw wamtes tasiyas.
